name: Android Dev
author: CostaFot
description: The Android developer's side of a device, on the bar: adb devices, packages and their actions, developer toggles, screenshots, deep links, APKs, the emulator, scrcpy and logcat, wireless debugging.

barWidget.description: adb for the Android developer: devices, packages, toggles, screenshots, APKs, emulators. Click for the panel.

schema.label: adb binary
schema.description: Empty auto-detects: $ANDROID_HOME or $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, then ~/Android/Sdk/platform-tools, then PATH.

schema.label: Screenshot folder
schema.description: Empty uses Omarchy's screenshot folder (OMARCHY_SCREENSHOT_DIR, else your Pictures folder).

schema.label: Recording folder
schema.description: Empty uses Omarchy's screen recording folder (OMARCHY_SCREENRECORD_DIR, else your Videos folder).

schema.label: APK folder
schema.description: Where the APK manager looks for .apk files.

schema.label: Extra scrcpy arguments
schema.description: Appended to the scrcpy command line, split on whitespace.

schema.label: Mirror with the screen off
schema.description: scrcpy turns the device's screen off and keeps it awake while mirroring (--turn-screen-off --stay-awake).

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Desktop notifications for actions and captures.

schema.label: Device notifications
schema.description: Notify when a device connects or disconnects.

schema.label: Show system apps
schema.description: List every package, not only third-party ones.
